governance.attested_by: OWNER-PROMOTED to ERCOT keeper 2026-07-18 (owner directive: 'Rebase and promote'). ercot81 nonreleasable-as, session 2026-07-18 (the ERCOT-79/80 successor lane, first delta). The ercot80 keeper recipe + ONE mechanism: ercot_nonreleasable_as_withholding — the published pre-RTC+B RRS/Reg-Up HASL carve-out (Nodal Protocols 6.5.7.6.2.3/3.17: no price-based SCED release in any pre-RTC+B year; the 2024-08-01 release reform was ECRS-only; RTC+B go-live 2025-12-05 ends the regime) represented as rigid at-cap reserve demand steps, exactly as ercot_ecrs_conservative_deployment already represents pre-reform ECRS. Zero fitted scalars: requirements are the measured AS plan net of the standing LR/storage-award credits; the only new inputs are published design dates. The mechanism removes an RTC+B-era price-responsive shed ramp the 2023-2025 market did not have; tight-hour energy duals now climb the offer surface as SCED did under the withheld-capacity design (IMM 2023 SOM artificial-shortage mechanism, applied at its published product scope).
governance.note: Single-delta A/B against the ercot80 keeper (rule-16 single-year 2023 probe, same machine): Aug-2023 monthly residual -99.1 -> -64.9 $/MWh (model 92.6 -> 126.8 vs RT 191.7 on the probe's dw basis), Jun -21.1 -> -12.1 and Sep -31.5 -> -22.1 (the ERCOT-78/79 shoulder over-shoot does NOT re-inflate), 2023 >$1000 tail 32 -> 38 h vs actual 61, false-positive >$200 count unchanged at 8 h. 2024/2025 near-inert outside already-formed tight hours (monthly moves <= ~$2). The remaining Aug-2023 mid-band ($200-1000 at measured RTOLCAP ~7.9 GW, model $59-104) is the ledgered offer-formation family (ERCOT-75/77 whole-stack mid-rung level), not a reserve-design gap.

exceptions.magnitude: 57h vs RT actual 181h (0.31x, FAIL — rubric v2.7 RT basis); 2024 22h vs 53 (0.42x FAIL); 2025 0h vs 31 (0.00x FAIL)
exceptions.reason: SCARCITY-TAIL COLLAPSE ON THE UNIT-ONLY AVAILABILITY ENVELOPE (ERCOT-80). Same structural finding as ERCOT-79: the deposed ercot76 keeper caught the real scarcity tail (2023 179h vs 181) on PHANTOM fleet tightness manufactured by the CAMPD facility-outage detector (daily-cycling CC folded into summer-long false outages). The outage-detection consolidation (PR #2415) deletes the facility layer entirely and makes the per-unit event-based detector the sole outage layer (measured CEMS + EIA-930, no residual), removing the phantom more completely; the tail stays collapsed (57h vs 181; on the real August/summer scarcity hours the model settlement price falls far short). One availability mechanism owned BOTH the Jun/Sep shoulder over-shoot (fixed at ercot79) and the caught tail (un-caught). This is out-of-admissible-representation for the CURRENT offer/scarcity calibration, which was fitted against the phantom-tightened fleet; it is NOT a single-lane mechanism gap. Successor lane: re-calibrate the ERCOT offer curves + ORDC/co-opt against the corrected availability envelope so the real scarcity re-forms on real fleet tightness. Until then ERCOT is NOT-YET.
